name: @query-studio/mobile
description: Query Studio for Android and iOS. Same engine, same UI, wrapped natively.

scripts.add:android: cap add android && npm run icons
scripts.add:ios: cap add ios && npm run icons
scripts.build:android: cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.dist:android: npm run build:android && npm run package:android
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release
